memories.title: Amarillo Ballfields
memories.text:
Many childhood memories, although a bit foggy, of Danny as we competed in sports like YMCA Baseball and Kids Inc football in our early years in Amarillo. In fact, we competed against each other all the way through high school. Danny has always been a great athlete and a great storyteller. One of the stories he loves to tell is about a hanging curve ball he threw over the middle of the plate in the Amarillo High/ Tascosa game our junior year. It’s one of the few times I took advantage of him and hit an opposite field triple earning a couple of RBI’s to help our team (AHS) clinch a win.  

There are numerous stories around escapades with Ross, Watson and Buckley that shall be forever fondly remembered but rarely shared to protect the innocent.

memories.title: Dick Bivins Stadium
memories.text: Dan was quarterback for Tascosa Rebels from ‘73, ‘74 and 75’.  He threw the longest touchdown pass on record.  I believe it was to James Mayberry!

memories.title: Tascosa High School
memories.text: Quarterback Danny Ross, with his best bud, Running Back James Mayberry. James was inducted into the THS Rebel Hall of Fame and the Panhandle Sports Hall of Fame

memories.title: Tascosa High School
memories.text: When I was a freshman at Tascosa High School and starting JV quarterback, I recall wanting to fill the large shoes you left behind as one of the all-time great Rebel qb’s. Of course, filling your shoes made sense to me, since I knew I could never fit into those all-too-tiny, skin-tight, blood-clotting short shorts you wore so divulgenly well.

memories.title: Fleetwood Park
memories.text:
1. Camping with me, Debbie, Danny and Taylor as a 2 year old! They let me come with them. Such a sweet memory. I was around 14 years old and we ‘showered’ with a bucket of cold water hanging from a tree! It was so much fun. 
2. Going on big walks with Uncle Danny around his neighborhood and even Amarillo at Fleetwood Park talking about all the things of life… I appreciate how much time he has invested in me as his niece - all the love and laughs!
3. He gave Elli her first haircut 😂 But then he saved the lock of hair for me!

memories.title: 18245 Pine Vista Place
memories.text: Our Russell family of 5 has memories of sleeping over with Danny and Debbie in their home in Colorado Springs. Danny and Debbie were always super hospitable to us. I remember big meals, walks around their backyard garden, walks around the neighborhood and the boys’ old toys they would put out for my kids to use. Danny would talk about how the buffs were playing, old hunting buddies, his boys and splash in a bit of some controversial politics.These are really good memories!! Thank you, Danny, for being such a great uncle!
